script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Family
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

EXT. SUBURBAN NEIGHBORHOOD - DAY

A picturesque suburban neighborhood bustles with life.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
The Johnson family had it all - a beautiful home, loving parents, and happy children. But beneath the surface, they were growing restless. Each member of the family harbored a secret ambition.

INT. JOHNSON KITCHEN - MORNING

MRS. JOHNSON (40s) prepares breakfast, humming contentedly. JAMES (12) enters, wearing a determined expression.

JAMES
Mom, can I talk to you about something?

MRS. JOHNSON
Of course, sweetie. What's on your mind?

JAMES
I want to learn how to bake a cake. I want to make the best cake ever.

INT. MR. JOHNSON'S STUDY - LATER

MR. JOHNSON (50s) sits at his desk, engrossed in work. EMMA (16) enters, her eyes filled with fire.

EMMA
Dad, can I talk to you about something?

MR. JOHNSON
Sure, Em. What's on your mind?

EMMA
I've been accepted into the prestigious art program at the local university. I want to pursue my dream of becoming a professional artist.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

The family gathers around the TV, watching the evening news. LUCY (9) sits, her eyes fixed on the screen.

LUCY
Dad, can I be an astronaut?

MR. JOHNSON
Absolutely, Lucy. But it will take hard work and dedication.

INT. JOHNSON KITCHEN - EVENING

Mrs. Johnson bakes a cake, her face filled with pride as James helps.

MRS. JOHNSON
James, this is a great start. But remember, the best part is not just the finished product, but the journey to get there.

INT. MR. JOHNSON'S STUDY - NIGHT

Mr. Johnson works late, but he pauses to send an email to the university, securing Emma's acceptance.

INT. ART SCHOOL - DAY

Emma begins her first day at art school, filled with excitement and trepidation.

INT. SCIENCE CLASSROOM - DAY

Lucy excels in science class, her mind filled with dreams of the stars.

INT. JOHNSON KITCHEN - NIGHT

James proudly presents his family with the best cake he's ever made.

JAMES
I may not have made the best cake yet, but I'll keep trying.

INT. MR. JOHNSON'S STUDY - EVENING

Mr. Johnson receives a call from the university, offering him a position as a professor.

MR. JOHNSON
I've always wanted to teach, but I never thought I'd have the opportunity.

INT. ART GALLERY - NIGHT

Emma's artwork is displayed in a prestigious gallery, eliciting gasps of awe from the crowd.

EMMA
(whispering to herself)
I did it.

INT. JOHNSON LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Lucy gazes up at the night sky, her eyes filled with wonder and determination.

LUCY
I will become an astronaut.

FADE OUT.

THE END
